app_tagline: Create music, songs & videos — rate with MN2 crypto

lyrics.prompt_template: Write original song lyrics for a {genre} track titled "{title}". Mood: {mood}. Include verse, chorus, bridge. Keep under 400 words.

music_structure.prompt_template: Describe BPM, key, instrumentation and section timings for a {genre} song: "{title}". Return JSON with bpm, key, sections array.

video_prompt.prompt_template: Create a visual storyboard for a music video matching song "{title}" ({genre}). Lyrics excerpt: {lyrics_excerpt}. Return 3-5 scene descriptions.

encoder_modes.label: Full Song + MV
encoder_modes.description: Complete pipeline: lyrics, instrumental+vocal audio, music video, and sync mux.
encoder_modes.music_prompt: full song with vocals and production

prompts.lyrics: Write original song lyrics for a {genre} track titled "{title}". Mood: {mood}. Include verse, chorus, bridge. Keep under 400 words.
prompts.music_structure: Describe BPM, key, instrumentation and section timings for a {genre} song: "{title}". Return JSON with bpm, key, sections array.
prompts.video_prompt: Create a visual storyboard for a music video matching "{title}" ({genre}). Lyrics excerpt: {lyrics_excerpt}. Return 3-5 scene descriptions.

encoder_modes.label: Instrumental
encoder_modes.description: Beat and melody only — no vocals. MusicGen/Suno instrumental path.
encoder_modes.music_prompt: instrumental only, no vocals, {genre} production

prompts.music_structure: Describe BPM, key, and instrumentation for an instrumental {genre} track "{title}". Mood: {mood}. No vocals.

encoder_modes.label: Lyrics Writer
encoder_modes.description: Generate song lyrics and structure only — no audio or video rendering.

prompts.lyrics: Write polished song lyrics for "{title}" in {genre} style. Mood: {mood}. Include verse, pre-chorus, chorus, bridge. Under 500 words.
prompts.music_structure: Return detailed song structure JSON for "{title}": bpm, key, chord progression, section bars.

encoder_modes.label: A Cappella
encoder_modes.description: Vocal-only track via TTS — no backing music generation.

prompts.lyrics: Write vocal-focused lyrics for a cappella "{title}" ({genre}). Mood: {mood}. Emphasize harmonies and vocal lines.

encoder_modes.label: Music Video
encoder_modes.description: Cinematic music video focus with synced audio — visual storyboard priority.
encoder_modes.music_prompt: cinematic underscore matching video scenes

prompts.video_prompt: Design a high-production music video for "{title}" ({genre}). Lyrics: {lyrics_excerpt}. Describe camera moves, lighting, and 5 distinct scenes.

encoder_modes.label: Short Reel
encoder_modes.description: 30-second vertical social clip — hook-first lyrics and fast-cut visuals.
encoder_modes.music_prompt: short catchy hook, social media reel, 30 seconds

prompts.lyrics: Write a 30-second hook and one verse for "{title}" ({genre}). Mood: {mood}. TikTok/Reels style, punchy.
prompts.video_prompt: Vertical 9:16 reel visuals for "{title}". Fast cuts, bold colors. Lyrics: {lyrics_excerpt}.

encoder_modes.label: Podcast Jingle
encoder_modes.description: 15-second intro/outro sting for podcasts and shows.
encoder_modes.music_prompt: podcast intro jingle, 15 seconds, memorable sting

prompts.music_structure: Design a 15-second podcast jingle for "{title}". BPM, key, and hit points.

encoder_modes.label: Ambient Loop
encoder_modes.description: Long ambient soundscape loop — soft tone fallback, optional static visual.
encoder_modes.music_prompt: ambient soundscape, evolving textures, no drums

prompts.video_prompt: Slow abstract ambient visuals for "{title}" — particles, gradients, minimal motion.

encoder_modes.label: Remix Edit
encoder_modes.description: Remix-style arrangement with drop sections and stem-oriented structure.
encoder_modes.music_prompt: remix edit with build-up, drop, and breakdown sections

prompts.lyrics: Write minimal vocal hooks for a remix of "{title}" ({genre}). Mood: {mood}. Focus on repeatable chants.
prompts.music_structure: Remix arrangement JSON: intro, build, drop, breakdown, outro with bar counts.

encoder_modes.label: Beat Maker
encoder_modes.description: Drum-focused beat pack — kicks, snares, hi-hats pattern emphasis.
encoder_modes.music_prompt: drum beat, 808s, hi-hats, no melody vocals

prompts.music_structure: Describe drum pattern, BPM, and swing for a {genre} beat "{title}".

encoder_modes.label: Lo-Fi Chill
encoder_modes.description: Study beats with vinyl crackle vibe — mellow tempo defaults.
encoder_modes.music_prompt: lo-fi hip hop, dusty drums, jazzy chords, study beats

prompts.video_prompt: Cozy lo-fi anime-style room loop for "{title}" — rain window, desk, warm lamp.

encoder_modes.label: Cinematic Score
encoder_modes.description: Orchestral film score with epic visual prompts.
encoder_modes.music_prompt: orchestral cinematic score, strings and brass, no vocals

prompts.video_prompt: Epic cinematic scenes for score "{title}" — wide shots, dramatic lighting, 4 scenes.

encoder_modes.label: EDM Banger
encoder_modes.description: Festival drop track — high BPM, build-drop structure.
encoder_modes.music_prompt: EDM festival banger, massive drop, sidechain bass

prompts.lyrics: Write short EDM vocal hooks and chants for "{title}". Mood: {mood}. Festival energy.
prompts.music_structure: EDM arrangement: build length, drop BPM, key, and FX cues.

encoder_modes.label: Hip-Hop Rap
encoder_modes.description: 16-bar verses with hook — rap-focused lyric template.
encoder_modes.music_prompt: hip-hop beat with boom bap or trap drums

prompts.lyrics: Write rap lyrics for "{title}" — two 16-bar verses, catchy hook, {genre} flow. Mood: {mood}.

encoder_modes.label: Rock Anthem
encoder_modes.description: Guitar-driven rock anthem with big chorus.
encoder_modes.music_prompt: rock anthem, distorted guitars, live drums, powerful chorus

prompts.lyrics: Write arena rock lyrics for "{title}" with powerful chorus. Mood: {mood}.

encoder_modes.label: Jazz Lounge
encoder_modes.description: Smooth jazz arrangement — brushed drums, upright bass mood.
encoder_modes.music_prompt: smooth jazz lounge, saxophone, brushed drums

prompts.lyrics: Write sultry jazz vocal lyrics for "{title}". Mood: {mood}. Scat-friendly phrasing.

encoder_modes.label: Classical Suite
encoder_modes.description: Classical composition structure — strings, piano, orchestral layout.
encoder_modes.music_prompt: classical suite, piano and strings, no vocals

prompts.music_structure: Classical suite form for "{title}": movements, keys, tempo markings.

encoder_modes.label: Kids Song
encoder_modes.description: Simple, friendly lyrics for children — bright mood defaults.
encoder_modes.music_prompt: kids song, playful melody, simple arrangement

prompts.lyrics: Write simple, fun kids song lyrics for "{title}". Mood: {mood}. Easy words, sing-along chorus.

encoder_modes.label: Karaoke Track
encoder_modes.description: Backing track + sing-along lyrics — vocal guide in metadata.
encoder_modes.music_prompt: karaoke backing track, no lead vocal

prompts.lyrics: Write sing-along karaoke lyrics for "{title}" ({genre}). Mark [Verse] [Chorus] sections clearly.

encoder_modes.label: Stem Export
encoder_modes.description: Multi-stem layout — drums, bass, synth, vocal layers in track metadata.
encoder_modes.music_prompt: multi-stem electronic production

prompts.music_structure: Stem layout JSON for "{title}": each stem role, levels, and pan.

encoder_modes.label: Live Jam
encoder_modes.description: Improvised live-session feel — loose structure, extended duration.
encoder_modes.music_prompt: live jam session, improvised feel, room ambience

prompts.lyrics: Write loose jam-session lyrics and cues for "{title}" ({genre}). Mood: {mood}.
prompts.video_prompt: Live stage jam visuals for "{title}" — band, crowd, warm lights.

encoder_modes.label: Mashup Mix
encoder_modes.description: Two-genre mashup concept — blended structure in prompts.
encoder_modes.music_prompt: genre mashup, blended transitions, DJ mix style

prompts.lyrics: Write mashup-friendly vocal snippets for "{title}" blending {genre} and pop. Mood: {mood}.
prompts.music_structure: Mashup timeline: genre A section, transition, genre B section with BPM changes.

encoder_modes.label: Trailer Hype
encoder_modes.description: Epic trailer music + rapid-cut hype visuals.
encoder_modes.music_prompt: epic trailer music, risers, impacts, no vocals

prompts.video_prompt: High-energy trailer montage for "{title}" — quick cuts, lens flares, title cards.

encoder_modes.label: Sleep & Calm
encoder_modes.description: Meditation/sleep audio — low freq tone fallback, gentle visuals.
encoder_modes.music_prompt: sleep meditation drone, soft pads, no percussion

prompts.video_prompt: Calming sleep visuals — stars, slow clouds, deep blue gradients for "{title}".

encoder_modes.label: MN2 Crypto Anthem
encoder_modes.description: MasterNoder-branded crypto anthem — MN2 and node themes in lyrics.
encoder_modes.music_prompt: crypto anthem, hype trap beat, anthemic hook

prompts.lyrics: Write a crypto anthem for "{title}" celebrating MN2 tokens, masternodes, and MasterNoder.dk. Mood: {mood}. Hype rap verses + anthem chorus.
prompts.video_prompt: Futuristic crypto visuals for "{title}" — blockchain nodes, neon charts, MN2 branding.
